mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_auto_price_log(symbol, price, volume, created_at) VALUES(#{symbol}, #{price}, #{volume}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO tb_auto_order_log(symbol, side, quantity, price, reason, created_at) VALUES(#{symbol}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO tb_auto_position(symbol, quantity, avg_price, updated_at) VALUES(#{symbol}, #{quantity}, #{avgPrice}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = VALUES(quantity), avg_price = VALUES(avg_price), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
INSERT INTO tb_auto_strategy(symbol, strategy_type, status, created_at) VALUES(#{symbol}, #{strategyType}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, price, volume, created_at AS timestamp FROM tb_auto_price_log WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, symbol, side, quantity, price, reason, created_at FROM tb_auto_order_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, symbol, price, volume, created_at FROM tb_auto_price_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_auto_position WHERE quantity > 0
